entries.subject: ESA/Hubble heic1505b
entries.finding: Galaxy cluster MACS j1149.5+223: Hubble ACS and WFC3, from 814 nm to 1.6 µm, the shortest wavelengths blue and the longest red; 3800 × 3800 px over 1.90 arcmin, CC BY 4.0. The file's embedded sky tags, used as they are: 0.03000 arcsec per pixel, north 0.0° left of vertical, the frame's centre at 177.400369075°, 22.400300529°. Not measured against Gaia here; the same publishers' tags were within 0.4 arcsec on four cluster pictures and 1.5 arcsec off on one deep field.
